description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Wattala, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512000
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in the Wattala area. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
